chapter_card: The Word That Saved Millions · ~1.5 s
set_language: Gentle Georgian Gloucestershire, 1770s-1790s: soft green hills and hedgerows, stone cottages with shutters, a timber dairy byre with wooden pails, Jenner's panelled study in Berkeley with a garden window, a Soho hand-press shop in 1798; painted-parchment maps and globe; an 1881 Victorian lecture theatre and a plain 1980 assembly hall. One brown-and-white cow (the same cow every time).
explorer_lock: ONE beat (13_explorer_meadow): pats the cow, holds the little book beside her, laughs and walks off along the hedge.
forbidden: HARD REJECT: Orbit robot; photoreal; Ken Burns or still push; sores, pus, rashes, blood, wounds or needles in skin (cowpox and smallpox are never shown as marks beyond two or three soft healed round marks on a hand); plague imagery (crosses on doors, carts of bodies, sick people); readable text, numbers or logos baked into the plate (VACCA, VACCINE, dates, the case-book, the Inquiry title page, headlines and board text are overlays in the edit); garbled writing; unfinished flat cards; unfinished Explorer hair; twin Explorer; Explorer at a Short's frame 0; a flame, lamp or glow on a Fast plate; a gavel (P7); Pasteur in a skullcap at the lectern (P5). Never say 'same DNA' or 'lab DNA' in a Veo prompt.
always_fails: unfinished Explorer hair or melted face
motion_lock: Real Veo camera and object motion on every plate. No freeze-pad, no loop, no Ken Burns. A reuse row cuts a different window of a KEEP clip; never a still.
quality_note: Flow first for picture, then the HOS Vertex project (gen-lang-client-0538779324) only, never past £0: veo-3.1-generate-001 for Quality, veo-3.1-fast-generate-001 for Fast, 4/6/8 s clips. Quality only for a named person's face, a crowd, the Explorer, or a glow/sunbeam/candle hero. A Fast take with a flame, lamp or glow in frame fails. One plate at a time until the first KEEP; after 2 same-framing FAILs change the framing.
labels: White Didot italic side label, 1-4 words, one at a time, on the plate's first beat; added in the edit. Never two at once.
